title: Mona Patrol
description: Drive Mona across lunar craters, mines, and rolling hills while battling Bug and CVE saucers from A to Z.

controls.action: Jump craters, mines, and rolling stones
Fire forward laser and upward anti-air cannon
Toggle chiptune music and sound effects

instructions: Leap lunar craters and Stage 3+ landmine combinations, blast craggy boulders and Stage 4+ rolling stones, and shoot down swooping Bug Droppers and crater-carving CVE Bombers overhead across checkpoints A to Z. Audio starts off; use the game's own sound, stage, theme, and touch controls.
